description: Gen Z Soft Club is a revival of the Gen X Soft Club aesthetic that emerged in the late 2010s and gained popularity during the early 2020s. This aesthetic is often referred to as a style that focuses on the hyper-glossy, high-shine optimism of the mainstream Y2K ephemera, which leans heavily into a moody, minimalistic, and understated urban vibe that drew inspiration from the tech advertisements, underground electronic music from the raw city infrastructure and the millennium era of the 1990s/2000s.
